intro: Stolen Supplies tasks adventurers with recovering plundered highland goods from the Al'Aketh in Falaath Village. Caravan ambushes have cut off vital shipments of food and windstones between the lowlands and the Shen'dar Highlands, leaving local skyborne communities on the brink of starvation.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I overheard you might be going to Falaath Village? While you are there, please keep an eye out for our stolen supply caches.

The Al'Aketh have been raiding our supply caravans carrying various goods such as food and windstones to and from the lowlands for months. They've been blaming the bandits, of course, but we all know that it all ends up in the same place. If there's any of that stuff left in Falaath, it would be a huge help if you could recover it.

clips.title: Progress
paras: There's a lot of hungry and desperate skyborne here who need these supplies.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is great! We've been barely squeaking by without our regular supply deliveries. I'll work with the constable to ensure that these supplies get redistributed to the townsfolk who are in most dire need.
